items.title: 67520_George Handy oral history interview
items.q: I mentioned the name to you last night, Michael Loring; he wasn't one of the most popular bands in the country.

ctx.x: You had had a vast spectrum there in the very early days. Where did you go then after Scott?
I don't remember the order of things, but there were trips with various bands. I mentioned the name to you last night, Michael Loring; he wasn't one of the most popular bands in the country.
Was he a hotel band? As they refer to now, a sweet band?
